evidence: Judge agent + model: task/task.toml:30-35 [verifier.env] is the frozen shared block (REWARDKIT_JUDGE = "claude-code", REWARDKIT_MODEL = "z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx", ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api", ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}", ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = ""), byte-matching staged-task-contract.md lines 66-71. All five judge.toml files (gates/render, gates/constraints, scored/functional, scored/polish, scored/visual) have only judge = "claude-code" at line 2 in [judge]; no model, temperature, reasoning_effort or weight key. Judge CLIs/browser: task/tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical (diff) to the frozen template tests/Dockerfile; it pins @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (lines 16-22) and harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 (line 31); Chromium is installed via the pinned @playwright/mcp's bundled playwright cli (lines 33-38) and every judge.toml passes --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium. Shared tools: task/tests/tools/score.py and restart_mcp.py and task/tests/test.sh are byte-identical (diff -q) to the template copies, so no drift. Fixed clock / graded time rules: the brief, rules note and criteria contain no date-dependent graded rule (no deadlines, ages, expiry or 'today' logic). The only timed requirement is a latency bound ('appears by itself within 15 seconds', hireops_rules.md section 5), which is independent of the run date. Seed timestamps are fixed historical values (messages created_at '2026-07-01T10:07:00Z', notes '2026-07-20T10:00:00Z'). The golden uses new Date() only to stamp new rows (src/index.js:59) and orders messages/activity by id (index.js:158,166,189), so its graded output does not depend on the run date. Adversarial tries: (a) a broken app cannot exploit the clock because no criterion reads a date-derived value; (b) a conforming app that orders by its own wall-clock timestamps still yields newest-first/in-order results on any monotonic clock, so it does not fail because of the run date. Open verifier network ([verifier.environment] network_mode = "public", task.toml:37-38) is explicitly not a defect. Notes (not defects; all inherit from the unchanged template Dockerfile): base images are tag-pinned (node:22-bookworm-slim, python:3.12-slim) rather than digest-pinned, and transitive dependencies (playwright inside @playwright/mcp, rewardkit's pip deps) inherit their pinning from the pinned top-level packages; installed versions were not checked in a built image during this review. Run verdict: static/source review only. No configured judge run was exercised for this row, and pinning is a static property.
